name: RW04-B1 Catalog and price reader
description: RW04-B1 (RW04 real-world test). Reads the 10 tagged test products of the store, then the same items on the public practice sites (Sauce Demo after a demo sign-in, Books to Scrape), checks the component behaviour of RPA Challenge and DemoQA, normalizes SKU, price, currency and stock, confirms each product's identity, converts to EUR, flags price drift and writes the catalogue snapshot. It never changes a product.

variables.name: base
variables.description: Folder of the real-world tests: data, output and the stand-in server.

variables.name: run_id
variables.description: Run id shared by a main agent and its children; made here when empty.

variables.name: standin
variables.description: Address of the local QA stand-in server (127.0.0.1 only).

variables.name: watch
variables.description: Show message boxes and pause between records so a person can follow the run.

variables.name: pause_seconds
variables.description: Pause after each record when watch is on.

variables.name: fault_profile
variables.description: none, or resilience: the stand-ins inject the five failures of runbook step 09.

variables.name: exceptions
variables.description: Records routed to the exception list.

variables.name: status
variables.description: success when every record was handled (routed exceptions included).

variables.name: result_file
variables.description: CSV file with one row per record.

variables.name: demo_password
variables.description: Sauce Demo's public demo password from the vault (rw_qa_standins/saucedemo/password; a person enters it there).

variables.name: drift_tolerance
variables.description: Price drift (per cent) above which a product is flagged.

variables.name: evidence_file
variables.description: Evidence rows of this agent (one per record).

args.text: What this agent does: Reads the 10 tagged test products of the store, then the same items on the public practice sites (Sauce Demo after a demo sign-in, Books to Scrape), checks the component behaviour of RPA Challenge and DemoQA, normalizes SKU, price, currency and stock, confirms each product's identity, converts to EUR, flags price drift and writes the catalogue snapshot. It never changes a product. It works through 10 test SKUs and writes its results to the run's output folder.
